Welcome to THE DOG VET 🐾. An educative  platform where we discuss and learn all things canine.

I’m Dr Hastings Sadziwa, a qualified and practising Veterinarian sharing practical, easy-to-understand advice to help you raise a healthy, happy dog.

On this channel, you’ll learn a lot about dogs including but not limited to: 

New puppy care basics,
How to choose the right puppy,
Dog health, nutrition, and disease prevention, and 
Common mistakes dog owners should avoid. 

My goal is to give you real veterinary guidance you can trust—whether you’re a first-time dog owner or experienced.

New videos every week.
Subscribe and take better care of your dog with THE DOG VET.
